title: Shapes: Flat and Solid
seo_title: Shapes – Kindergarten Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Name and describe flat shapes (circle, triangle, square, rectangle) and solid shapes (cube, ball, box, cone, cylinder); count sides and corners. (summary of the NERDC Kindergarten Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free kindergarten maths worksheets for Nigeria: circles, triangles, squares and rectangles, solid shapes, sides and corners, and shapes around us. 100 picture questions with answers.
key_sub: A triangle has 3 sides. A square has 4.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Flat shapes are drawn on paper. Solid shapes can be held.
  • Count the straight sides and the corners.
  • A circle has no corners.

Examples

Example

How many sides does a triangle have?

Count: 1, 2, 3

Answer: 3

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Calling a rectangle a squareA square has 4 sides the same length.
Thinking a turned square is a new shapeTurning does not change the shape.
Mixing up a circle and a ballA circle is flat. A ball is solid.
